fixedFindings.summary: The neutral client-document writer delegated in-memory create and supersede operations without its own runtime-policy assertion, while the direct Engagement proxy map omitted several externally sensitive document methods.
fixedFindings.repair: ClientDocumentWriterService now asserts attachment_external_write before delegation; the direct Engagement map now covers createAttachmentFromBuffer, supersedeAttachment, reconcileFailedAttachmentDeletes, and readAttachmentBytes; shadow and active regression tests were added.

fixedFindings.summary: Recall event processing required external-action and generic callback permission but did not enforce the independently movable recallWebhookEnabled owner flag.
fixedFindings.repair: The runtime policy now exposes assertRecallWebhookEnabled, and receiveWebhook/handleBotEvent require the Recall-specific owner in addition to callback and external-action permission.

fixedFindings.summary: The new client-document denial regression was included in the Phase 1 TypeScript project but not executed by the focused Jest gate.
fixedFindings.repair: The permanent Phase 1 verifier now invokes client-document-writer.service.spec.ts explicitly.

acceptanceBlockers.requiredClosure: Complete the independent validation package after both executable gates pass.

notes: Static inspection found the request/core timers neutralized and explicit worker shells as sole timer registrars.
Callback ownership is checked at controller and provider boundaries.
Recall processing now requires the independently movable Recall owner flag.
External client-document operations now fail closed at both the narrow writer and direct Engagement service boundary.
Exact-version review identity, authorization, version decision, and review stamping are rechecked in one transaction.
Raw AI credential resolution requires InternalServiceGuard and runtime policy; provider error bodies and transport errors are bounded.
Capability client scope and ethical-wall authorization fail closed.
Raw Recall body parsing is shared by main and engagement-api before signature verification.
Static inspection is not executable acceptance evidence.
